Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets plc Q1 2025, dated 8 May 2025. Worth noting for anyone reading the series: LBCM's leverage ratio steps from 4.4% here to 8.2% at 30 June 2025 and 8.0% at 30 September. That is not a transcription error - both quarters were checked against their own LR2 tables, and the Q3 2025 report's comparative columns repeat 4.4% for March, so the Tier 1 position genuinely roughly doubled in the second quarter. A footnote to this table also records that the March and September positions exclude the preceding quarter's profits.
